lines: Here is what actually happens inside Sentry, at level one: the report to the forecaster, from Rosa's refill.
Its payload holds her name, her birth date, and her medical record number.
Classification reads it: it finds each value, names its type, and gives it its tags and its sensitivity.
Her name is found right here: personal data, restricted. A check that sees only this message has enough.
So the input Sentry sends to O P A reads: personal data, restricted, going to an external, untrusted destination.
The first and third rules fire on her name.
O P A combines the rules, most restrictive first: risk level critical, suggested enforcement: block.
Sentry raises an alert and recommends the block.
The courier gets her name and address too. It runs inside the organization, so that call is allowed.
